narr: A complex of thunderstorms dropped southeast from Tennessee. Outflow from these thunderstorms produced new strong to severe thunderstorms over north Alabama during the mid to late morning hours. There were several reports of wind damage, including a measured wind gust of 58 mph at the Huntsville International Airport. An EF-0 tornado produced a short track of damage in Higdon. Rainfall of 1 to 3 inches fell in a very short period of time producing brief flash flooding as well on the north side of the Quad Cities.
ev: Flash flooding on Columbus Street in Albertville. At least 6 inches of water over the roadway. Report relayed via social media.
Intersection of Highway 75 and Highway 35 in Rainsville has between 1 and 1.5 feet of water covering the roadway.
Portions of 6 city streets were under water, with around 3 feet of water over the roads at one point.
